## Before building

- [ ] Wireframe added to `docs/wireframes/` and linked here
- [ ] Spec written in `docs/screen-specs/` and linked here
- [ ] Data fields it needs exist in `ews-mobile/model/`

## Before merging

- [ ] Built with the prompt in `docs/ai-prompting-template.md` (one screen per prompt)
- [ ] Reviewed against the wireframe, in all three profiles
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm run colors:audit` pass
